//@version=6
indicator("LuxQuant - Premium & Discount Zones - micky v1.0", shorttitle="LuxQuant - Premium & Discount Zones - micky v1.0", overlay = true, max_boxes_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500)

// --- Inputs ---
int pivotLeft = input.int(15, "Pivot Left", minval = 1, group = "Settings")
int pivotRight = input.int(15, "Pivot Right", minval = 1, group = "Settings")

// Colors & Style
color premiumColor = input.color(#f23645, "Premium Color", group = "Style")
color discountColor = input.color(#089981, "Discount Color", group = "Style")
int currentTransp = input.int(80, "Current Zone Transparency", minval = 0, maxval = 100, group = "Style")
int histTransp = input.int(95, "Historical Zone Transparency", minval = 0, maxval = 100, group = "Style")

// --- Calculations ---
float ph = ta.pivothigh(high, pivotLeft, pivotRight)
float pl = ta.pivotlow(low, pivotLeft, pivotRight)

var float topLevel = na
var float botLevel = na
var int topIndex = na
var int botIndex = na
var int startIndex = na

var box currentPremiumBox = na
var box currentDiscountBox = na

var label currentPremiumLabel = na
var label currentDiscountLabel = na

// Plotting Swing Labels
if not na(ph)
    label.new(bar_index - pivotRight, ph, "HH", color = color.new(premiumColor, 50), textcolor = color.white, style = label.style_label_down, size = size.small)

if not na(pl)
    label.new(bar_index - pivotRight, pl, "LL", color = color.new(discountColor, 50), textcolor = color.white, style = label.style_label_up, size = size.small)

float highestHigh = ta.highest(high, pivotLeft + pivotRight)
float lowestLow = ta.lowest(low, pivotLeft + pivotRight)

// Updating Zones
if not na(ph) or not na(pl)
    // Set new levels and track their indices
    if not na(ph)
        topLevel := ph
        topIndex := bar_index - pivotRight
    if not na(pl)
        botLevel := pl
        botIndex := bar_index - pivotRight
        
    if na(topLevel)
        topLevel := highestHigh
        topIndex := bar_index - pivotRight
    if na(botLevel)
        botLevel := lowestLow
        botIndex := bar_index - pivotRight
        
    // Calculate the start index to encompass BOTH the current top and bottom pivots
    startIndex := math.min(topIndex, botIndex)

    // Update historical transparency and end them right before the new box starts to prevent overlap
    if not na(currentPremiumBox)
        box.set_bgcolor(currentPremiumBox, color.new(premiumColor, histTransp))
        box.set_border_color(currentPremiumBox, color.new(premiumColor, histTransp + 5))
        box.set_right(currentPremiumBox, startIndex)
    if not na(currentDiscountBox)
        box.set_bgcolor(currentDiscountBox, color.new(discountColor, histTransp))
        box.set_border_color(currentDiscountBox, color.new(discountColor, histTransp + 5))
        box.set_right(currentDiscountBox, startIndex)
        
    // Delete old text labels
    if not na(currentPremiumLabel)
        label.delete(currentPremiumLabel)
    if not na(currentDiscountLabel)
        label.delete(currentDiscountLabel)

    float midLevel = math.avg(topLevel, botLevel)
    
    // Draw New Boxes
    currentPremiumBox := box.new(left = startIndex, top = topLevel, right = bar_index, bottom = midLevel, 
      border_color = color.new(premiumColor, 50), 
      bgcolor = color.new(premiumColor, currentTransp))
      
    currentDiscountBox := box.new(left = startIndex, top = midLevel, right = bar_index, bottom = botLevel, 
      border_color = color.new(discountColor, 50), 
      bgcolor = color.new(discountColor, currentTransp))
      
    // Draw New Labels
    currentPremiumLabel := label.new(bar_index, topLevel, "Premium", color = color.new(color.black, 100), textcolor = premiumColor, style = label.style_label_left, size = size.small)
    currentDiscountLabel := label.new(bar_index, botLevel, "Discount", color = color.new(color.black, 100), textcolor = discountColor, style = label.style_label_left, size = size.small)
else
    // Extend current boxes and labels
    if not na(currentPremiumBox)
        box.set_right(currentPremiumBox, bar_index)
        label.set_x(currentPremiumLabel, bar_index)
        label.set_y(currentPremiumLabel, topLevel)
    if not na(currentDiscountBox)
        box.set_right(currentDiscountBox, bar_index)
        label.set_x(currentDiscountLabel, bar_index)
        label.set_y(currentDiscountLabel, botLevel)
